title: Herdr socket client package (internal/herd/client)
description: Foundation + contract tick. Go package internal/herd/client: a minimal typed client for the herdr unix-socket JSON API (protocol 19; authority: herdr api schema --json). Socket path resolution per skills/ticks/references/runners-config.md: explicit path arg -> $HERDR_SOCKET_PATH -> ~/.config/herdr/herdr.sock. Cover: request/response envelope with ids and error mapping; Ping/status; the request methods the helper needs (worktree.create/list/remove, agent.start/prompt/wait/list/get, pane.read, pane.wait_for_output, session.snapshot aka api snapshot) and, critically, events.subscribe + events.wait — the push-event surface the herdr CLI does NOT expose and the reason this client talks to the socket directly instead of shelling out. Context: the CLI-visible surface is documented in skills/ticks/references/herdr-runner.md; the socket schema is discoverable live. Design for testability: transport injected; unit tests against an in-process fake unix-socket server replaying captured protocol JSON; optional live round-trip test gated behind HERDR_ENV=1 + a guard env var (skip by default in CI). Stdlib only — add NO new go.mod dependencies in this tick (the config tick owns dependency additions to avoid lockfile collisions). Protocol drift guard: on connect, read the protocol version and fail closed with a clear error if it is not the pinned one.
